user.title: TL Remote — role of this HA
user.description: Node — this HA exposes devices. Main — this HA connects to another HA.

connection.title: Connect to node
connection.description: Enter the address of the source HA (node) and its long-lived access token (Profile → Tokens).

reconfigure.title: Change connection settings
reconfigure.description: Change the connection parameters to the node. Token — long-lived access token of the node (Profile → Tokens).

error.missing_endpoint: TL Remote (node) is not installed on the remote HA

abort.reconfigure_not_supported: Reconfiguration is only available for the main instance

expose.title: Which devices to expose
expose.description: Select the entities of this HA that should appear on the main HA instance.

prefix.title: Entity prefix
prefix.description: Optional prefix added to incoming entity ids.
